title.narrative: Percentage of acute healthcare facilities with isolation capacity
Percentage of monthly and quarterly project M&E reports submitted on time
Percentage of eligible households provided with food and basic supplies within quarantined populations
Country adopted personal and community non-pharmaceutical interventions (school closures, telework and remote meetings, reduce/cancel mass gatherings)
Percentage of suspected cases of COVID-19 cases that were investigated, laboratory confirmed and reported based on national guidelines;
Number of health staff trained in infection prevention and control per MOH-approved protocols (disaggregated by sex)
Number of refurbished/upgraded health facilities implementing customer satisfaction survey
At least one multi- sectoral simulation exercise conducted by the EOC with results incorporated into national COVID-19 preparednessand response plans
Number of annual progress reports submitted complete and on time
At least two meetings per year of an intersectoral committee on One Health (MoH, Ministry of Agriculture, Ministry of Environment) to ensure strengthened surveillance in the human-health-environment
Number of designated laboratories with staff trained to conduct COVID-19 diagnosis
Country has activated their public health Emergency Operations Center or a coordination mechanism for COVID-19
Country has prepared a referral system to care for COVID-19 patients
M&E system established to monitor COVID-19 preparedness and response plan
Percentage of PHC facilities implementing exit surveys in a one-year period, present to MOH, and implement action plan to address issues as part of Project Operational Plan
Community Health workers trained in event based surveillance for COVID-19 and other epidemic-prone diseases (disaggregated by sex)
Laboratory technicians trained on COVID19 diagnosis as well as in 5 key priority diseases as per the IHR (2005) (disaggregated by sex)
Percentage of population vaccinated, which is included in the priority population targets defined in national plan [disaggregated by sex]
A National Deployment and Vaccination Plan (NDVP) implemented with input from relevant bodies (Text)
Community engagement plan implemented for increasing demand creation for the Covid-19 vaccine by the population
Effective Vaccine Management assessments implemented with composite scores of 80% or higher (Text)
Pharmacovigilance System (PVS) adapted to detect Adverse Events Following Vaccination (AEFI) for the COVID-19 vaccine
Vaccine stock management tools and operating procedures updated to reflect the characteristics of COVID-19 vaccines.
Solar capacity installed at health facilities supported by the project
Number of eligible health facilities with improved operational cooling and refrigeration equipment financed by the Project
Campaign to sensitize the public to adopt behaviors for the control of dengue and other vector transmitted diseases
Percentage of suspected cases of dengue that were investigated, laboratory confirmed, and reported, based on National Guidelines
Laboratory Capacity to identify dengue serotypes
